title: Marlow Leaf Studios
text:
Marlow Leaf Studios

notes:
Inbound from self-serve signup — founder requested a discovery call (lead from product hunt listing).
Founder-led call 2026-03-01: Aisha (founder) very technical, previously experimented with OpenAI for prototypes.
Main asks: 1) straightforward pricing examples vs OpenAI/Anthropic for 50k and 500k monthly tokens; 2) latency numbers for small prompt+response on hosted API; 3) whether Redwood supports on-the-fly model fallback to smaller models for cost savings.
Quote: "We need simple math — how much will this cost per active user per month compared to what we run now. If Redwood is ~30% cheaper and similar latency, we can switch."
Willing to start with hosted API; no enterprise contract yet. Wants predictable monthly estimate for 3 month POC.
Security: not enterprise-grade yet, but wants SSO on roadmap and audit logging for future investors. No strict data residency requirement — US preferred.
Technical: mobile-first app, average prompt length ~80 tokens, response ~220 tokens, want batching/caching recommendations to reduce cost.
Pricing sensitivity: target spend <$2k/month to start, long-term goal <$10k/month as user base grows.
Notes from SE: recommend small-batch window, KV-prefix caching for repeated system prompts; consider cheaper 7B fallback for low-confidence queries.

next_step:
Send clear pricing comparison vs OpenAI + short cost model for 50k tokens/month; schedule follow-up call week of 2026-03-15 with founder
